body_markdown:
AmpliTech Group is excited to be attending Mobile World Congress in Barcelona, Spain, March 1-4, 2027. The future of next-gen connectivity is here, and it’s powered by AmpliTech’s 5G ORAN innovation.


Find us at Hall 5 | Booth #5A11 to learn about our innovative ORAN platforms and connect with the team shaping the next chapter of global connectivity.


[Send us a note today to schedule a meeting with us.](https://www.amplitechgroup.com/contact-us/)
